<p class="project-page-intro">
Inference runtime systems and serving engines for efficient model deployment.
</p>

<div class="project-stack">
  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/nano_vllm_pp" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="project-row-title">nano-vLLM: Single-GPU LLM Inference Runtime</span>
    <span class="project-row-meta">Token-budget continuous batching, chunked prefill, and OpenAI-style serving with TTFT/TPOT/KV telemetry. Paged KV tables, refcounts, and parent-hash prefix caching were audited over 1,500 seeded operations. On 12 mixed-length Qwen3-0.6B requests, output throughput rose from 58 to 223 tokens/s versus single-sequence scheduling; all 12 greedy outputs matched in the prefix-reuse experiment.</span>
  </a>
</div>
